alternatives.text: Pip the rabbit reaches for a toy cabinet with a sticky note. The note clings to Pip's finger instead. Peeling splits it into one note per hand. Each pull doubles the notes from two to four to eight. Pip sees the note-covered reflection in a mirror, gasps, then sneezes the notes onto the cabinet. Pip is relieved but the cabinet stays messy.

The cabinet catches the flying notes, leaving Pip relieved beside a messy cabinet.

TITLE / FORMAT
Pip sticky notes / 15 seconds

VISUAL STYLE
Bright playful animation, clear silhouettes.

CHARACTER / CONTINUITY
Pip is the same anthropomorphic rabbit throughout. No verified appearance reference is supplied.

TIMED SHOT PLAN
0-2s: Pip the rabbit wants to place one sticky note on the toy cabinet's empty front panel. Pip reaches toward that panel, but the note clings to the fingertip while a visible gap remains between hand and cabinet. [locked medium shot; Show the cabinet panel and reaching fingertip in the same view; preserve the visible gap.] -> The note attaches to the wrong surface.
2-5s: Pip peels with the other hand and the note splits into two, one on each hand. [medium shot; Both hands remain visible with one note on each hand.] -> One note remains on each hand.
5-10s: Each pull doubles the sticky notes from two to four to eight; the paired hands stay apart so each changed note count is visible before the next doubling, progressively covering Pip's arms and face. [wide shot; Keep separated hands and both changed note groups visible without cutting across a doubling.] -> The doubling covers Pip's arms and face.
10-12s: Pip turns the note-covered face toward the mirror, sees the reflection and gasps while both the face and reflected notes remain visible. [medium close-up; Keep the covered face and its mirror reflection readable in the same shot.] -> Pip gasps and stays covered.
12-15s: Pip remains covered until a sneeze scatters the notes onto the cabinet's formerly empty front panel. Pip is relieved, but the cabinet remains messy. [medium shot; Keep the previously empty panel visible as the sneezed notes land; end on the messy panel and relief.] -> Pip is relieved beside the messy cabinet.

AUDIO
Playful background music, peeling sounds, a gasp and a sneeze. No dialogue.

NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS
No identity changes, extra pulls, new mechanics, readable lettering claims or additional story events.

FINAL CUT
End with the relieved Pip beside the visibly messy cabinet.
